messages.author: a1bf76ab9a5a2d4b
messages.subject: Re: Shiny R web application, calling external Javascript library
parts:
You just want to know if it's possible to include external JS scripts in a Shiny app?

If that's the question, then yes, it's simple. Here's an example of adding a dummy javascript file I made that's hosted online

library(shiny)
jsfile <- "https://gist.githack.com/daattali/7519b627cb9a3c5cebcb/raw/91e8c041d8fe4010c01fe974c6a35d6dd465f92f/jstest.js"

runApp(shinyApp(
  ui = fluidPage(
    tags$head(tags$script(src = jsfile))
  ),
  server = function(input, output) {
  }
))
